Authentication._comment: OIDC-client settings only. The auth MODE is not configured here: skein-web takes it from skein-api (SKEIN_AUTH_MODE via GET /api/v1/internal/instance-config) at startup. Setting Authentication__Oidc__Authority selects native OIDC for an SSO mode; empty = legacy trust-headers via oauth2-proxy. ClientSecret is injected from a secret store, never committed.
Authentication._commentLogoutRedirectUrl: Absolute sign-out URL of the authenticating proxy in front of this deployment (e.g. https://proxy.example.com/oauth2/sign_out). Only used in the legacy trust-headers mode. Empty = logout clears the local cookie only and warns at startup that the external session survives. Override with Authentication__LogoutRedirectUrl.
